name: Rubber Stamp & Riso Ink
summary: Two riso inks and two rubber stamps: teal '✓ WATCHED' on every healthy slip, one coral 'HOLD — YOUR CALL' on the anomaly.
look: Warm grainy paper printed in teal and fluorescent coral with 3–6 px misregistration, halftone dot disks and translucent multiply overprints. Distressed rubber stamps with double-ruled frames slam onto printed slips and cards.

components.name: Plate pair
components.role: hero words printed twice in teal + coral, multiply-blended, slightly off register

components.name: Halftone disk
components.role: one-ink dot screen fading out behind the mark and CTA

components.name: Rubber stamp
components.role: double-ruled uppercase stamp with noise-mask distress and edge wobble

components.name: Round seal
components.role: circular stamp with text on a path

components.name: Inspection slip
components.role: small printed form per metric; the anomaly gets the big coral slip

components.name: Paper stock
components.role: warm grain background with soft, low shadows

motion.name: Stamp slam
motion.how: scale 1.4 → 1 in 120 ms power4.in plus a two-frame 3 px shake, always on a kick or snare at 120 BPM

motion.name: Plate drift
motion.how: coral plate wanders 1–3 px on a 2 s sine loop (one bar) between hits

motion.name: Ghost lift
motion.how: stamp lifts 20 px and fades, leaving a 40% impression that inks in over 300 ms

story: Hook: 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.' over a pile of riso-printed dashboard cards, stamped 'FOUND TOO LATE · by a customer'. Reveal: teal then coral plates print 'Acme Pulse' over a coral halftone disk behind the mark, a round 'NOW WATCHING · 14 METRICS' seal thuds in. Proof: metric slips each get a teal '✓ WATCHED'; the checkout slip shows −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231, gets a coral HOLD stamp, and the human stamps a solid ROLL BACK. CTA: 'You ship. Pulse watches.' in overprint, lockup, and a solid coral START FREE stamp.
adapt: Turn each item your product checks (orders, PRs, invoices, leads) into a slip; stamp routine ones in your brand color and give the exception its own loud stamp plus a human-action stamp.

references.note: risograph look and ink misregistration explained

fit.risk: zine feel may undercut precision; keep layouts rigid and numbers crisp
